items.title: Flour
items.detail: 2 1/4 cups of all-purpose flour to build structure.

items.title: Butter
items.detail: 1 cup (220g/2 sticks) of unsalted butter, softened.

items.title: Baking Soda
items.detail: 1 teaspoon of baking soda and sometimes baking powder to help the cookies rise.

items.title: Salt
items.detail: 1/2 teaspoon of salt to balance the sweetness and enhance flavor.
